notes:
{角切|かくぎ}り is a cutting technique where ingredients are cut into small cubes.

TECHNIQUE:
Typically 1-2 cm cubes, though size varies by recipe. Common for potatoes, vegetables, and meat in stews and soups.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {角切|かくぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dice/cube
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角切|かくぎ}り: larger cubes
- {小|こ}さめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{角切|かくぎ}り: smaller cubes

OTHER CUTTING STYLES:
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: irregular cuts (rolling cut)
- ⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧: rectangular strips
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧: thin slices
- ⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧: julienne (thin strips)
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slices
